name: toast
title: Toast
description: Short notification in the bottom right corner that dismisses itself, triggered with the toast() function or an event.

props.name: title
props.description: Toast title. Option for toast() or the markas-toast event detail.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds before the toast dismisses itself. 0 keeps it until closed.

props.name: initial
props.description: Blade only: toasts shown right away, for example from a session flash.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label of each toast close button.

props.name: regionLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the live region.

a11y: The region uses role status and aria-live polite, so new toasts are announced without moving focus.
The timer pauses while a toast is hovered or holds focus, and resumes once both are gone.
The close button is labelled by closeLabel and reachable with Tab.
The entry animation is turned off under prefers-reduced-motion.

ai.whenToUse: Short feedback after a user action, such as data saved or failed to send.
rules: Mount only one Toaster in the main layout
Do not put important actions only inside a toast
Use duration 0 for errors that must be read before closing

id.description: Notifikasi singkat di pojok kanan bawah yang hilang sendiri, dipicu lewat fungsi toast() atau event.

props.title: Judul toast. Opsi untuk toast() atau detail event markas-toast.
props.duration: Milidetik sebelum toast hilang sendiri. 0 berarti tetap tampil sampai ditutup.
props.initial: Khusus Blade: daftar toast yang langsung tampil, misalnya dari flash session.
props.closeLabel: Label aksesibel tombol tutup di setiap toast. Isi "Tutup" untuk situs berbahasa Indonesia.
props.regionLabel: Label aksesibel region live. Isi "Notifikasi" untuk situs berbahasa Indonesia.

a11y: Region memakai role status dan aria-live polite, jadi toast baru dibacakan tanpa memindahkan fokus.
Timer berhenti saat toast di-hover atau berisi fokus, lalu lanjut setelah keduanya lepas.
Tombol tutup punya aria-label dari closeLabel (default Close) dan bisa dijangkau dengan Tab.

ai.whenToUse: Umpan balik singkat setelah aksi user, misalnya data tersimpan atau gagal terkirim.
rules: Pasang satu Toaster saja di layout utama
Jangan menaruh aksi penting yang hanya ada di toast
Pakai duration 0 untuk error yang harus dibaca sebelum ditutup
